inputs.text: Original 2D animated-film character key art: one adult courier with a short asymmetrical black bob, a small ivory crescent pin at the left temple, a muted coral raincoat with one large patch pocket, navy trousers and navy boots. Three-quarter full-body view in a blue-violet night space, face, hands and large coat pocket clearly readable. The courier holds exactly one folded ivory paper star with visible crease lines just outside the pocket, below eye level. Asymmetrical cinematic composition with negative space to the right, elegant clear silhouette, restrained expression and purposeful pose. Hand-drawn controlled ink contours, refined flat cel shading, subtle print grain, strong cinematic light-and-shadow shapes, dimensional staging through foreground and background silhouettes, original animated-film still quality. Color direction v2: large deliberate blue-violet shadow masses against selective vivid vermilion light, with warm apricot midtones and a pale ivory paper-star focal point. The coat has a muted coral material color, but colored light must affect the face, hands, coat and nearby surfaces together; do not preserve neutral local colors under every light. Keep the foreground, subject and distant space separated by hue and value. Preserve clean large color shapes; print grain is subtle and must not muddy them. Strong saturation is selective, not uniform across the whole image. Adult proportions and expressive believable hands; no kawaii icon, paper puppet, simple vector sticker, photorealism or 3D doll. No letters, logos or watermark. S01 color staging: deep eggplant-black foreground, blue-violet middle distance, a lighter subdued violet far plane. A narrow vermilion key light catches the pocket and extracting hand. Most of the frame remains dark; the one paper star is the smallest and brightest accent. Keep the trousers distinct from the floor with a restrained violet edge. The warm light is still confined to the action area.
